meta.title: Suggested Action used instead of a typed prompt

steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen where the technical-stage AI assistant is available.
Provide the required event title for the create flow.
Create a technical stage, which supplies the RFP question sections targeted by the Suggested Action.
Work on the technical stage before opening its AI assistant.
Apply the technical-stage template so its question sections are available.
Open the RFP Generator AI chat panel.

args.goal: In the open Ask Clara panel, select either the Vendor Assessments or Line Items section, record its current questions, click one of the available Suggested Actions, send it, and stop only when the chosen section visibly shows changed questions compared with its initial state.

steps.note: Perform the case-specific Suggested Action interaction and verify the chosen section's questions changed.
Confirm the AI interaction completed without an application error.
